title: Tech Challenges test
description: A timed, graded set of challenges. Lives in <tests folder>/<test-id>/test.json; question folders can sit next to it. Guide: docs/tests.md

id.description: Unique id. Defaults to the folder name (recommended: leave it out).

title.description: Name shown in the Tests group and in the results file.

description.description: Short text shown in the tooltip, e.g. what the test covers.

durationMinutes.description: Time limit. When it runs out, answers are submitted automatically and the test is locked.

enumDescriptions: Exam: hints and AI hints are off; large pastes/AI completions, time outside VS Code and an enabled GitHub Copilot are recorded as warnings in the results.
Open book: hints, AI hints and the internet are allowed.

maxSubmissions.description: Submissions allowed per question. The best one counts. Run (sample tests) is unlimited.

id.description: A challenge folder inside this test folder, or the id of any loaded challenge (e.g. "even-or-odd").

points.description: Points for this question. Partial credit = points × tests passed / total tests.
